QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] When the Spirit Tree Bloomed
QuestInfo.0: The Small Spirit said that back when the Spirit Tree blossomed, there was no Vortex of Light. Are the vortex and the wild spirits connected?
QuestInfo.1:
The Small Spirit needs time to compose himself. 
Talk to it again later.
QuestInfo.2: Once, the Spirits lived happily alongside the Spirit Tree and the harmonious song of the forest. But one day, the song of the forest stopped. Shortly after, the Spirit Tree began to wilt, and the Vortex of Light appeared.

0.msg: #bI can't stop. How can I find a way past the vortex of light?#k

1.msg: This place was once full of life. Back then, everyone was happy.

2.msg: (Sighs) Just thinking about it makes me sad.

yes.0: (Sniffs) I'm going to need a moment...

no.0: (Sniffs) Just thinking about it makes me sad.
